text.p: Winnipeg Commodity Exchange canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0836 CDT.

CANOLA - C$0.50 to C$1.00 a tonne down on lower CBOT soy calls and rain on Canada's Prairies. Commercials, however, were said to be offering cash premiums of C$8 to C$15 a tonne with Louis Dreyfus rumored to be offering up to a C$20 premium in attempt to entice farmer selling, traders said. July WCE futures crush margin rose to -1.69 Wednesday from +1.93 Tuesday. Canada's dollar opened firmer at C$1.3921 versus the U.S. dollar, rose to 81.86 yen, rose to 1.2453 marks.
FLAXSEED - C$0.50 to C$1.00 up on UGG short covering, traders said.
WESTERN BARLEY - Steady to C$0.50 down on CBOT corn calls. Alberta Wheat Pool was expected to continue selling barley spreads.
FEED WHEAT - Steady to C$0.50 down on CBOT corn and wheat calls.
PEAS - Steady to US$0.50 down on CBOT soymeal calls.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
